title: LightOn-rerank: one reranker for text and page images | reranker.uk
description: LightOn-rerank review (Oct 2026): six Apache 2.0 rerankers (0.8B, 2B, 4B, pointwise or listwise) that score text and document page images, LightOn's ViDoRe V3 and BEIR runs against Qwen3-VL-Reranker and jina-reranker-m0, and how to run them.
og_title: LightOn-rerank — text and page images in one reranker
og_description: Six Apache 2.0 models. The listwise 4B leads LightOn's visual-document comparison; on text it trails jina-reranker-m0.
